turns.text: Hi there! In your own words, what is this problem asking you to find?
Um, how much money the agent spent on all the ads together?
Right. How could you find what he spent on just the newspaper ads?
Good. And how would you find what he spent on the television ads?
Okay, so you have two amounts now. What would you do with them to answer the question?
Add them, so 250 plus 1125 is 1375. He spent $1375.
Can you explain why adding those two amounts gives the total spent?
Because newspaper ads and TV ads are separate costs, so the total is both of them put together.
